continuity_scope: Terms-only audit bound to the English-language The Dark Eye Core Rules, the Fifth Edition core product released by Ulisses Spiele/Ulisses North America. Official English launch material says the full Core Rules PDF became publicly available June 21, 2016; the English line announced a second printing on November 16, 2016. German-language editions and publications, supplements, the Aventurian Almanac, novels, card games, video games, virtual-tabletop modules, and home campaigns are separate witnesses and are not merged.

coverage_rule: No individual characters are included. The accessible official English Core Rules overview identifies Aventuria, rules, hero creation, species/cultures, professions, magic, divine work, creatures, and artifacts, but provides no stable claim-level profile for a named dramatic individual from the selected core witness. Cultures/species, professions, deities unless individually profiled, magic, items, Aventuria, and rules remain terms/context.
omissions: All named individuals, deities, NPCs, card-game characters, video-game protagonists, examples, and historical figures because the selected accessible English Core Rules witness does not provide claim-level individual dramatic profiles.
All content unique to German-language TDE editions, German sourcebooks, localizations, and any translation not expressly present in the selected English core witness.
All claims from the Aventurian Almanac, Aventurian Compendium, Magic/Gods of Aventuria, adventures, fiction, card games, virtual-tabletop modules, video games, and home campaigns.
All unverified corrections, retcons, continuity reconciliations, and adaptation assertions beyond the narrow printing/product metadata cited.
uncertainties: The English Core Rules are a Fifth Edition product, but this audit does not establish exact textual equivalence, source priority, or retcon relationships with any German-language Fifth Edition printing or other localization.

Ulisses announced an English second printing in November 2016 but the accessible announcement does not enumerate rule changes. No official English Core Rules errata document with a confirmed date/version was accessed; the second printing is recorded as a product-maintenance boundary only.

Ulisses presents the Aventurian Almanac as a recommended setting source and later books as rule extensions. They are deliberately excluded: a recommended/required companion or digital module is not evidence for core-only claims.

The English line page uses terms such as ‘race,’ culture, profession, and gods to organize a fictional game world. This audit treats them as source-native game/setting labels without mapping them to real human categories, real religions, or historical peoples.

Aventuria contains warfare, cults, slavery, prejudice, supernatural threats, and other potentially sensitive fantasy material. The audit neither generalizes these elements to real groups nor treats fictional conflict as factual cultural description.
evidence_basis: Official Ulisses English material identifies the 2016 Fifth Edition Core Rules as the book sufficient to play, gives it a 418-page core scope, and describes its Aventuria setting, hero creation, combat, magic, divine work, species/cultures, professions, creatures, and artifacts. Official release/second-printing material establishes the English product timeline; the virtual-tabletop page identifies a TDE5 digital core module as a distinct adaptation. No accessible official core witness gives claim-level named-character profiles, so this is a terms-only rules/setting audit.
